verses.sanskrit:
शौनक उवाच।
              ये सर्पाः सर्पसत्रेऽस्मिन्पतिता हव्यवाहने। तेषां नामानि सर्वेषां श्रोतुमिच्छामि सूतज॥१॥
verses.english: Shaunaka said: O son of Suta, I desire to hear the names of those snakes, that fell into the fire of the Snakesacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              सहस्राणि बहून्यस्मिन्प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। न शक्यं परिसंख्यातुं बहुत्वाद्द्विजसत्तम॥२॥
verses.english: Sauti said: O best of the twice-born, they were many thousands, tens of thousands and millions and billions; so great was their number that I am unable even to count them.

verses.sanskrit: यथास्मृति तु नामानि पन्नगानां निबोध मे। उच्यमानानि मुख्यानां हुतानां जातवेदसि॥३॥
verses.english: As far as I remember, hear, I shall mention the names of the principal snakes that fell into the fire.

verses.sanskrit: वासुकेः कुलजातांस्तु प्राधान्येन निबोध मे। नीलरक्तान्सितान्घोरान्महाकायान्विषोल्बणान्॥४॥
verses.english: Hear first the names of the chief ones of Vasuki's family, they were of colour, blue, red and white; they were of terrible forms, huge bodies and dreadfully poisonous.

verses.sanskrit: अवशान्मातृवाग्दण्डपीडितान्कृपणान्हूतान्। कोटिशो मानसः पूर्णः शलः पालो हलीमकः॥५॥
verses.english: Helpless and miserable, affected with their mother's curse, they all fell into that sacrificial fire as libations of ghee. (They were) Kotisha, Manasa, Purna, Shala, Pala, Halimaka, Pichchhala, Kaunapa, Chakra, Kalavega Prakalana, Hiranyabahu, Sharana Kakshaka and Kaladantaka.

verses.sanskrit: पिच्छलः कौणपश्चक्रः कालवेगः प्रकालनः। हिरण्यबाहुः शरणः कक्षकः कालदन्तकः॥६॥
एते वासुकिजा नागाः प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहने। अन्ये च बहवो विप्र तथा वै कुलसंभवाः। प्रदीप्ताग्नौ हुताःसर्वे घोररूपा महाबलाः॥७॥
verses.english: These are the snakes, born of Vasuki, that fell into the fire. O Brahmana, numerous other fearful and powerful snakes, born in the family of Takshaka, were burnt in the blazing fire. Hear, I shall mention their names now.

verses.sanskrit: तक्षकस्य कुले जातान्प्रवक्ष्यामि निबोध तान्। पुच्छाण्डको मण्डलकः पिण्डसेक्ता रभेणकः॥८॥
उच्छिखः शरभो भङ्गो बिल्वतेजा विरोहणः। शिली शलकरो मूकः सुकुमारः प्रवेपनः॥९॥
verses.english: Puchchhandaka, Mandalaka, Pindasektta, Rabhenaka, Uchchhikha, Sharabha, Bhangas, Bilvatejas, Virohana, Shili, Shalakara, Mooka, Sukumara, Pravepana, Mudgara, Shishuroman, Suroman and Mahahanu.

verses.sanskrit: मुद्गरः शिशुरोमा च सुरोमा च महाहनुः। एते तक्षकजा नागाः प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहनम्॥१०॥
पारावतः पारियातः पाण्डरो हरिणः कृशः। विहङ्गः शरभो मेदः प्रमोदः संहतापनः॥११॥
verses.english: These snakes, born of Takshaka, fell into the fire. Paravata, Pariyata, Pandara, Harina, Krisha, Vihanga, Sharabha, Meda, Pramoda, Sanhatapan these, born in the family of Airvata, fell into the fire.

verses.sanskrit: ऐरावतकुलादेते प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहनम्। कौरव्यकुलजान्नागाञ्शृणु मे त्वं द्विजोत्तम॥१२॥
एरकः कुण्डलो वेणी वेणीस्कन्धः कुमारकः। बाहुकः शृङ्गवेरश्च धूर्तकः प्रातरातकौ॥१३॥
verses.english: Now hear, O best of Brahmanas, the names of the snakes, born in the family of Kauravya, that I mention. Eraka, Kundala Veni, Veniskandha, Kumaraka, Bahuka, Shringavera, Dhurtaka, Pratara and Ataka, these, born in the Kauravya family, fell into the fire.

verses.sanskrit: कौरव्यकुलजास्त्वेते प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहनम्। धृतराष्ट्रकुले जाताञ्शृणु नागान्यथातथम्॥१४॥
कीर्त्यमानान्मया ब्रह्मन्वातवेगान्विषोल्बणान्। शङ्कुकर्णः पिठरकः कुठारमुखसेचकौ॥१५॥
verses.english: Now hear, O Brahmana, I mention those born in the family of Dhritarashtra, they were all exceedingly powerful, as swift as the wind and full of virulent poison.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णाङ्गदः पूर्णमुखः प्रहासः शकुनिर्दरिः। अमाहठः कामठकः सुषेणो मानसोऽव्ययः॥१६॥
verses.english: Shankukarna, Pitharaka, Kuthara Mukha, Sechaka, Purnangada, Purnamukha, Prahasa, Shakuni, Dari, Amahatha, Kamathaka, Sushena, Manasa, Avyaya, Bhairava, Mundavedanga, Pishanga, Udraparaka, Rishabha, Vegavana Naga, Pindaraka, Mahahanu, Rakttanga, Sarvasaranga, Samridha, Pata, Vasaka, Varahaka, Viranaka, Suchitra, Chitravegika, Parashara, Tarunka, Mani, Skandha and Aruni.

verses.sanskrit: भैरवो मुण्डवेदाङ्गः पिशङ्गश्चोद्रपारकः। ऋषभो वेगवान्नागः पिण्डारकमहाहनू॥१७॥
रक्ताङ्गः सर्वसारङ्गः समृद्धपटवासकौ। वराहको वीरणकः सुचित्रश्चित्रवेगिकः॥१८॥
पराशरस्तरुणको मणिः स्कन्धस्तथारुणिः। इति नागा मया ब्रह्मन्कीर्तिताः कीर्तिवर्धनाः॥१९॥
प्राधान्येन बहुत्वात्तु न सर्वे परिकीर्तिताः। एतेषां प्रसवो यश्च प्रसवस्य च सन्ततिः॥२०॥
verses.english: O Rishi, the sons and the grandsons of the snakes were innumerable, therefore, I shall not mention their names to you.

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यं परिसंख्यातुं ये दीप्तं पावकं गताः। त्रिशीर्षाः सप्तशीर्षाश्च दशशीर्षास्तथाऽपरे॥२१॥
verses.english: Some of them had three heads, some seven and some ten. They had poison like the fire at the end of the Yuga and they were all terrible in appearance.

verses.sanskrit: कालानलविषा घोरा हुताः शतसहस्रशः। महाकाया महावेगाः शैलशृङ्गसमुच्छ्रयाः॥२२॥
verses.english: They had huge bodies and great speed, they were as tall as mountain peaks. Some of them were as long as a Yama, some a Yojana and some two Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: योजनायामविस्तारा द्वियोजनसमायताः। कामरूपाः कामबला दीप्तानलविषोल्बणाः॥२३॥
दग्धास्तत्र महासत्रे ब्रह्मदण्डनिपाडिताः॥२४॥
verses.english: They were capable of assuming any form at will and of mustering any strength at will, they had the poison like the blazing fire, (such were the snakes that) that were burnt in the great sacrifice, affected by Brahma's punishment, (their mother's curse.)
verses.bhavadeepa: योजनायामविस्तारा अपि मन्त्रसामर्थ्यत्स्वल्पप्रमाणाः । अगस्त्यकरगतसमुद्रवत् । वह्नौ प्रवेशयोग्या भवन्ति  ॥२३॥
